detail: This disclosure under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 indicates that Jarul Infrastructure has crossed a 25% shareholding threshold or is making an open offer for Rattan India Power. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure of acquisition patterns and shareholding to the stock exchange and public, serving as the gateway filing in a mandatory offer regime. The acquisition target is in the energy/power sector, a capital-intensive regulated domain subject to additional approvals.
